title: Logging prompts and outputs: what to keep, what to redact, and for how long

videos.script: Every call to a model can be written down. The question, the answer, who asked and how long it took. {{title}} Teams keep all of it, because nobody can fix a bad answer that was never kept. {{record}} But people type anything into a chat box. This lesson's log was written by the course. Half of its twenty-two records hold something nobody asked for, like a card number or a key. {{scan}} So the log turns into the most complete copy of your users' secrets, held by a team that never meant to hold them. {{secret}} You will decide which question each field answers, and keep each field only as long as that question lasts. {{tiers}} You will redact before anything is written, and see what a pattern cannot find. A name. An address. A phone number typed with spaces. {{miss}} Then you will delete on a schedule, keep what an investigation needs, and make the schedule prove that it ran. {{sweep}}
